name: conv_integer_input
comment: conv accepts integer/logical input (was: throw 'Not a double array'). MATLAB R2025b promotes to double — the result is ALWAYS double, never the integer class (unlike kron/cross). Branches: int8 'full' [1 3 5 3]; 'same' [3 5 3]; 'valid' [3 5]; int+double [1 3 5 3]; uint8 [1 3 5 3]; int16 [200 600 400]; logical [1 1 1 1]; double*double unchanged [4 13 28 27 18]. Values are plain double so no double() wrap needed. bugs/signal/conv-integer-input.md.
